scope: Three read-only helper investigations and lead review against original source; documentation/evidence only. No helper confidence is treated as executed integration proof.

required_corrections_integrated.finding: The compiler/freeze APIs cannot infer raw invalid state from a previously accepted candidate.
required_corrections_integrated.resolution: Guide now specifies atomic document-bound preparation and revision/state receipts, distinguishes standalone valid definitions and already frozen independent trials, and names the stale-candidate negative test.
Guide names existing authoring cases in test_creator_trial.gd and actual-control tests in test_creator_persistence_ui.gd.

required_corrections_integrated.finding: An unconditional semantic receipt requirement would wrongly exclude historical inspection-only revisions.
required_corrections_integrated.resolution: Guide preserves explicitly marked legacy-unbound inspection/new-revision policy and requires semantic proof before flight eligibility.

required_corrections_integrated.finding: Scratch post-climb state cannot be compared with a live tick-zero candidate.
required_corrections_integrated.resolution: Guide retains tick-zero context/checkpoint separately from the later climb-out result.

required_corrections_integrated.finding: Main.recorder and Main.flight_log are distinct owners.
required_corrections_integrated.resolution: Rollback finding identifies the F10 flight_log stream precisely and asks developers to inspect both lifecycle contracts.

required_corrections_integrated.finding: Ledger verifier did not bind derived dialect/mass fields or refusal diagnostics to verified source records.
required_corrections_integrated.resolution: Verifier now asserts those relationships, record-location uniqueness and prior error diagnostics; its final run passes.

independently_preserved_distinctions: Estimated-item reproposal is documented current policy, not a new defect.
Nested-root suppression is observed behavior with a compatibility-policy decision open.
Package cancellation observation does not prove late UI adoption.
Runtime log/context findings remain source-derived and unexecuted as whole-app flows.
The semantic cross-pair probe performs no Store publication, bundle admission or flight.
Lexical source inventory does not complete Phase0A or qualify a source aircraft.

fixture_reconstruction.method: Retained prepare_fixture.py reconstructed a second disposable directory and verified every source/configuration hash.
